title: Props (Glee) — Meaning, Genes, And Nothing Else #Shorts
description:
Props (Glee) did not evolve to be understood — only to be survived. "Props" is the twentieth episode of the third season of the American musical television series Glee, and the sixty-fourth overall. Written and directed by Ian Brennan, the episode is the first of two new episodes that aired back-to-back on Fox in the United States on May 15, 2012.

Strip Props (Glee) of its poetry and the mechanism underneath is stranger. VanDerWerff said he "could have done without" their duet, and Futterman was even harsher: "it was quite unfortunate". Houston Chronicle's Bobby Hankinson wrote that he "sort of liked" how the pair were "simultaneously improving upon and butchering a Taylor Swift song", and Saskin characterized it as "heartfelt and passionate".
